units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 67a:6">B. Mets. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>את ונ׳ אחי</he> (Rashi <he>ונַוְולָה</he>) thou and N. are relatives (and she will surely restore the field to thee whenever thou art able to redeem it).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 67a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>כל את ונ׳ אחי סמכא דעתיה וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80) in every case when such an expression as ‘thou and N. are relatives’ is used, the seller relies on it &c. [Oth. opin. <he>נ׳</he>, a colloquial expression for ‘a certain person’, as our ‘N. N.’, both male and female; v. Koh. Ar. Compl. I, p. XXI].
